name: Wrath Bearer
body:
When you can no longer spare the rod, you can at least spare the lives of your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Battle mystery, Craft Magic Arms and Armor.

Benefit: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls when wielding a magic weapon that you have created.
